concerns.location: spec.md:FR-003 / US-1 Scenario 3 / Edge Cases / Constitution VII
concerns.text: Band-gap bounds are stated inconsistently. FR-003 and US-1 Scenario 3 use the inclusive range '[0.0, 6.0] eV' and the Edge Cases section says a 0 eV (metallic) entry must be INCLUDED ('System must include it but flag it'), while Constitution Principle VII mandates strict bounds '0 eV < band gap < 6 eV'. Pick one convention (inclusive vs strict) and align FR-003, US-1, and the edge case.

concerns.location: spec.md:US-1 Independent Test vs US-1 Acceptance Scenario 2
concerns.text: US-1's Independent Test requires 'exactly 15-20 derived compositional columns' but Acceptance Scenario 2 requires only 'at least 5 distinct compositional descriptors'. These two thresholds for the same feature-engineering output are mutually incompatible; a pipeline satisfying one can fail the other. Reconcile to a single count/range.

US-3's Independent Test fixes a concrete pass bar 'Spearman rho > 0.5' while SC-003 says the correlation is 'measured against the literature baseline'. Two different references for the same validation criterion; state which one governs (or make both the same reference).

US-2 Scenario 2 requires only that RF's R² be 'strictly greater than' the mean baseline, while SC-002 requires 'statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05 after correction)'. The acceptance scenario is weaker than the success criterion for the same comparison; align US-2 Scenario 2 with the significance test in FR-005/SC-002.
